name: CalFresh (SNAP)
description: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits for low-income households in California.

conditions.label: Monthly income at or below 130% FPL for household size

deadline: Apply any time. Expedited service within 3 days if income < $150 and liquid assets < $100.
sources: 130% FPL 2025: household of 1 = $1,580/mo, +$620 per additional person (simplified)
